subject: Invoice delivery: tokenized portal primary + signed PDF fallback
messages:
From: Marie Lambert <accounts-payable@greenbridge.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery options & requirement for signed PDFs

Hi Michael,

Quick question from our AP team as we ready onboarding for Redwood: our GL requires a digitally signed PDF copy of every invoice for audit retention (12 months) and we'd like invoices pushed into our AR system via either SFTP drop (SFTP + file manifest) or a tokenized portal API (preferred for new vendors).

Couple of specifics we need confirmed before go-live:
- Is a P7S detached signature of the PDF available (we currently use that for supplier assurance)?
- If using the portal tokenized delivery, can we get a signed PDF copy emailed to accounts-payable@greenbridge.com as a fallback?
- Invoice numbering format and whether you can include the PO number on the PDF header (we require PO linkage).
- VAT / reverse-charge evidence: GreenBridge is EU-registered for some entities; what fields will you include to support reverse-charge reporting?

Can you loop in whoever runs billing for delivery and confirm the recommended default? We also need a sample invoice PDF and an example of the signature payload so our GL team can test ingestion.

Thanks,

Marie Lambert
Manager, Accounts Payable
GreenBridge Health

--
Attachment: requirements.csv (stub)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Marie Lambert <accounts-payable@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options & requirement for signed PDFs

Marie — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Connor (billing ops) and Kim (AP integrations) so we can cover the whole matrix.

Short answers up front:
- Yes: we can produce a detached P7S signature for each PDF we emit.
- Yes: portal will be the recommended primary path (tokenized delivery/webhook) and we can configure an emailed signed-PDF copy as a fallback for your AR ingestion.
- Invoice numbering: our invoices follow REDW-YYYYMMDD-##### by default, but we can append your PO like REDW-YYYYMMDD-##### (PO: <PO12345>) in the PDF header if that helps.
- VAT: we include seller VAT id, buyer VAT id (if provided), a tax_breakdown section line-by-line, and a reverse_charge flag when applicable. We will also include a field for the customer's VAT evidence reference (certificate id) if you can provide it.

Attachments I'm sending for testing: Sample-Invoice-202508.pdf (example payload) and invoice-signature-example.p7s (detached signature). Also a short provisioning link file with the portal onboarding steps.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm whether portal token delivery is acceptable as primary and whether the signed-PDF email fallback should be enabled for every invoice or only when portal delivery fails.
2) If fallback email is required, confirm the mailbox (accounts-payable@greenbridge.com) and whether the emails should be S/MIME encrypted or TLS-only.
3) If SFTP is still required as an alternative, share endpoint details and expected manifest schema.

Connor/Kim — can you comment on any retention or TTL constraints for portal tokens and whether we need to sign the payload or rely on TLS + detached P7S?

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options & requirement for signed PDFs

Adding detail from ops side — Michael covered the high level. A few operational notes:

- Portal tokens: we issue a short-lived delivery token (TTL default 24h) and a webhook acknowledgement. We can extend TTL to 72h for enterprise partners.
- Signed PDF: the P7S is generated by our signing service using an audited key; we can also provide an OCSP timestamp if GreenBridge needs stronger non-repudiation evidence.
- Email fallback: we can enable TLS-only or S/MIME. Enabling S/MIME requires exchange of public certs; if the AP team prefers TLS-only, we log envelope metadata and store the signed PDF in the portal audit log for 12 months.
- SFTP: available as a secondary path — we produce daily bundles (ZIP) with a manifest CSV and an index.json that lists invoice numbers, PO numbers and VAT flags.

Kimberly — please pick the default we should propose in the provisioning doc: portal primary + signed-PDF email fallback (TLS) or portal primary + SFTP fallback?

Connor
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marie Lambert <accounts-payable@greenbridge.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: cfo@greenbridge.com
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options & requirement for signed PDFs

Thanks — this is helpful. GreenBridge prefers the portal tokenized delivery as primary (audit trail is important) but the GL team requires a signed PDF emailed to accounts-payable@greenbridge.com for immediate processing. S/MIME would be our preference for the email channel, we can share the cert for encryption.

A few clarifications: please confirm the sample invoice contains these fields explicitly: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, seller_vat_id, buyer_vat_id, tax_line_items (with tax_rate, taxable_amount, tax_amount), and a reverse_charge boolean.

Also we need the invoice filename format to be consistent for automated pickup (e.g., GREENBRIDGE_REDW_20250819_INV000123.pdf). Is that configurable?

If you can send the portal provisioning link and a short checklist we can run a test next week.

Best,

Marie Lambert
Manager, Accounts Payable
GreenBridge Health

Marie — perfect, thanks for the confirmation. We'll set portal tokenized delivery as primary and enable S/MIME-signed PDF emails to accounts-payable@greenbridge.com as the default fallback (per your request).

I'll capture the agreed configuration in a short provisioning checklist and send it along with a test vector:
- Portal: token TTL 72h, webhook ack required.
- Email fallback: S/MIME encryption (please send public cert to kimberly_park@redwood.com). Signed detached P7S attached to each PDF.
- Filename convention: GREENBRIDGE_REDW_YYYYMMDD_INV##### (we'll start with INV000001).
- VAT fields: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, seller_vat_id, buyer_vat_id, tax_line_items (rate/amount), reverse_charge boolean, vat_evidence_id.
- Retention: signed PDFs and manifests stored in portal audit logs 12 months; exportable on request.

Next actions for your team:
1) Send S/MIME cert to kimberly_park@redwood.com (we will provision).
2) Confirm whether GL wants signed-PDF fallback for every invoice or only for the first 30 days while they test ingestion.
3) Preferred test window next week (we can run a single invoice-through-portal + signed-email test).

I'll draft the provisioning doc and a test checklist and push to the provisioning link (DocuSign / onboarding path) — expect that in the next few hours.

Thanks — Michael
